items.name: Private Yoga Classes
items.alt: Individual guidance during a seated yoga practice
items.text: Personal guidance shaped around your body, abilities, and goals. Practise at your own pace with focused attention and options that work for you.

items.name: Group Yoga Classes
items.text: Practise together with shared motivation and thoughtful guidance. Choose a basic or advanced group to explore movement at a pace that suits your experience.

items.name: Reiki Healing
items.alt: A calm studio prepared for practice
items.text: A gentle complementary practice in a quiet setting, with time to pause and rest. Get in touch to learn about our Reiki sessions.

items.name: Yoga for Seniors
items.text: A slower, welcoming practice with comfortable movement and options to suit individual abilities. Explore seated postures and gentle stretches with guidance.

items.name: Meditation Classes
items.alt: A man sitting in meditation on a beach
items.text: Make space for stillness through guided meditation. Explore mindfulness, focused attention, and quiet moments at your own pace.

items.name: Pranayam Classes
items.alt: A yoga practitioner seated with palms together
items.text: Explore gentle breathing practices with clear guidance. Learn to notice your natural breath and practise with a comfortable, unhurried rhythm.
